payload.query:
query gameMeta {
  gameMeta {
    gameLevels {
      objectId
      createDate
      updateDate
      deleteDate
      gameSeasonId
      title
      finishScore
      rewardGameItemId
      rewardClaimed
    }
    currentSeason {
      objectId
      name
      startDate
      endDate
      passGameItemId
      description
    }
    studentHouse
    studentGameItemId
    studentGameItemActivated
    selfPoints
    housesPoints {
      code
      name
      rank
      points
    }
    attendance
    dailyPractice {
      ...practiceFields
    }
    studentStats {
      points
      tasks
    }
  }
}

fragment practiceFields on Practice {
  id
  name
  type
  startDate
  endDate
  progress
  durationMinutes
  leftTime
  finishTime
  usedTime
  executionStatus
  expired
  processingTime
  content {
    ...practiceContentFields
  }
  assignedByUserId
  isTerminated
}

fragment practiceContentFields on PracticeContent {
  subThemes {
    categoryId
    themeId
    subThemeId
    score
    subThemeName
    subThemeNumber
    type
    isDeleted
    subjectId
  }
  tasks {
    categoryId
    themeId
    subThemeId
    subThemeName
    subThemeNumber
    taskId
    processed
  }
  courseModules {
    moduleId
    name
    courseId
    categoryId
  }
}
